title: Choose when search changes the answer
scenario: You are using an AI assistant that can answer from its training memory or search the live web. For one of these requests, only a live, sourced answer is safe to act on.
task: Pick the request that needs live sources before you trust the answer.

options.feedback: A stable concept — the explanation is the same this year as five years ago. Memory is enough.

options.text: Is the VAT rate for e-books in my country still 21%?
options.feedback: Rates change by law, and 'still' is the whole question — only a live, sourced answer can update it. This is the one to search.

options.text: Rewrite this email so it sounds friendlier.
options.feedback: A transformation of text you supplied — nothing outside the conversation is needed.

options.text: Summarize the attached report into five bullets.
options.feedback: The source is already in front of the model. No search needed.

hints: Would the correct answer have been different a year ago?
The word 'still' assumes yesterday's fact is today's — what could confirm that?
explanation: The test is whether the correct answer changes with time: laws, rates, prices, versions and schedules do; explanations and text transformations do not. 'Still 21%' assumes yesterday's fact is today's, and only live sources can confirm that.
